githubApp.title: Connect GitHub
githubApp.subtitle: Len pushes this project to your repository.
githubApp.lead: Connect your GitHub account and choose which repositories OpenLen can use. Then ask Len to “put it on GitHub”.
githubApp.privacy: OpenLen only sees the repositories you choose and never stores a GitHub token. To remove its access entirely, uninstall the app on GitHub.
githubApp.noRepository: No repository yet. Ask Len to “put it on GitHub” and it creates one.
githubApp.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect GitHub? Len won't be able to push or pull. The app stays installed on GitHub until you remove it there.

lenWatch.title: Len Watch
lenWatch.intro: If your published site stops loading, we let you know.
lenWatch.autoFixHint: Len starts fixing it as soon as it goes down. It uses your credits.
lenWatch.autoPublishHint: Publishes the fix without waiting for you, unless the security review or a data change stops it.
lenWatch.ownerOnly: Only the project's owner can change this.
